ui.pageTitle: Lesson 3 Recap Quiz - Learn AI Anywhere
ui.introSubtitle: Test your knowledge of algorithms and training

questions.question: What is an algorithm?
options: A random guess a machine makes
A step-by-step way to complete a task
questions.correctAnswer: A step-by-step way to complete a task

questions.question: Why does a machine need clear and detailed algorithms?
options: So it can talk with humans naturally
Because it can't understand like humans and needs exact steps to follow
So it can decide on its own without help
So it can work quickly without clear instructions
questions.correctAnswer: Because it can't understand like humans and needs exact steps to follow

questions.question: What happens during training for a machine?
options: It memorizes every example without checking for mistakes
It waits for humans to fix errors and tell it the right answers
It calculates a prediction, measures its error, and adjusts its equation
It keeps making the same prediction without improving
questions.correctAnswer: It calculates a prediction, measures its error, and adjusts its equation

questions.question: How do humans and machines process features differently?
options: Humans focus on what feels important, and machines use numbers
Humans turn features into numbers, and machines rely on feeling
Humans and machines both guess randomly
Machines understand emotions better than humans
questions.correctAnswer: Humans focus on what feels important, and machines use numbers
